info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Routing Decisions API
info.description: The Routing Decisions API enables financial institutions to efficiently manage and direct card transaction requests based on operational criteria. This endpoint is designed for the submission of transaction data to determine the appropriate routing path, enhancing processing efficiency and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements. Typical consumers include payment processors and banking platforms that need to optimize card transaction flows. By utilizing this API, developers can implement intelligent decision-making capabilities that improve transaction handling within their operations.

post.summary: Create a routing decision for card transactions.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create routing decisions based on card transaction criteria. The decision generated will determine the processing path for the specified card transaction, optimizing for efficiency and accuracy.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit routing decisions for card transaction switches. The payload must conform to the specified schema, which includes all necessary parameters required for processing the routing decision.
